change: On plugin failure, abort the session immediately and persist disabled configuration independently of runtime cleanup. Catch cleanup rejection and expose a redacted recovery message. Do not change production deadlines or automatically re-enable a failed plugin.

newCases: Pending cleanup does not delay exact on-disk revocation; commands are denied and repeated failure is idempotent.
Rejected cleanup still persists revocation without an unhandled rejection or private error details.

native.finding: Three actual renderer crashes emitted render-process-gone. Disabled/error state was observed while each crashed native window still existed, directly demonstrating independence from final window/storage cleanup. Explicit re-enabling waited for cleanup before creating the next runtime.
native.boundary: Run-specific observation intervals include polling and inspector capture. Not a universal latency guarantee, complete full-suite result, or proof of the earlier full-run running-state failure's cause.

environmentObservation: A separate read-only git diff command reported allocation failure during the build. The original build handle was retained and later completed with exit 0; no build was restarted or run concurrently by this task.
boundary: Source change only. Full component regression is recorded separately when terminal; full desktop regression, distribution validation, remaining design/capability work and hosted publication are still required.
